lines.text: It was built to wait for one signal.
Then the city began to go dark.
A sentry guards what matters. It just had to decide what that was.
And from the last lit window, someone answered.
It had never been waiting for the sky.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
